worlds.name: Classic World
worlds.description: Protected Classic world. Runtime Milestone 1 hosts Classic first and blocks transfers/AI contamination.
worlds.motd: Welcome to MajorMUD Reforged Classic. This host is authoritative and Classic remains protected.

notes: 0113 is Classic-first. Additional worlds are added by configuration and module/runtime services, not host rewrites.
Classic remains protected: no transfers, no AI mode, no formula invention.
The Host remains authoritative for world state, character state, combat, items, NPCs, quests, economy, timers, resets, and permissions.
Runtime Milestone 1 adds opt-in telnet networking and multiple sessions while keeping Classic as the only enabled world.
0133 creates a runtime-only test character when no saved or generated Classic character start is available. This character never modifies Librarium or generated Data.
worlds[].diagnosticRoom is map-qualified as room.map1.1 for explicit developer smoke testing only.
The runtime test avatar has no selected Classic class and bypasses character-creation validation only because IsRuntimeTestCharacter is true.
